([[Richardson, Texas]]) | college = [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] (2022–present) | highlights = * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2022) }} '''Cason Wallace''' (born November 7, 2003) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). {{Cite web |title=2022 Top Basketball Recruits |url=https://247sports.com/Season/2022-Basketball/RecruitRankings/?InstitutionGroup=HighSchool/ |access-date=2023-06-06 |website=247Sports |language=en-US}}He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and a top 5 player in the 2022 class. == High school career == Wallace attended [[Richardson High School]] in [[Richardson, Texas]]. As a senior, he was the [[Gatorade Basketball Player of the Year]] for Texas and the ''[[Dallas Morning News]]'' boys basketball Player of the Year after averaging 19.9 points, 7.4 rebounds and 6.1 assists per game.{{cite web | url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2022/03/17/richardsons-cason-wallace-is-named-gatorade-texas-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year/ | title=Richardson's Cason Wallace is named Gatorade Texas Boys Basketball Player of the Year | date=17 March 2022 }}{{cite web | url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2022/03/24/the-dallas-morning-news-2021-22-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-richardsons-cason-wallace/ | title=The Dallas Morning News' 2021–22 boys basketball Player of the Year: Richardson's Cason Wallace | date=24 March 2022 }} He was selected to play in the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022 McDonalds All-American Game]] and the [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web | url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2022/05/31/kentucky-basketball-coach-predicts-cason-wallace-go-scorer/9941708002/ | title=Can offensive game match Kentucky basketball freshman Cason Wallace's defensive work? }} === Recruiting === A five-star recruit, Wallace committed to the [[University of Kentucky]] to play [[college basketball]].{{cite web | url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/32580446/highly-regarded-recruit-cason-wallace-chooses-dream-school-commits-kentucky-basketball | title=Top-10 recruit Wallace chooses 'dream school' UK | date=8 November 2021 }}https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article255603661.html {{Bare URL inline|date=October 2022}} == Career statistics == {{NBA player statistics legend}} === College === Cason Wallace is a guard for the Kentucky Wildcats men’s basketball team. Cason Wallace has played 22 games in his freshman year for Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team.
